---
# pagetitle sets only the browser tab; the visible title is the H1 below, which
# also renders in the knit_child pkgdown embed.
pagetitle: "Repeat Measurements"
output:
  html_document:
    mathjax: null
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars"
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: true
    css: styles.css
params:
  dfResults: NA
  dfMetrics: NA
  lListings: NA
  dSnapshotDate: NA
  nWindowLength: NA
  strFlagRule: "count"
  vFlagThresholds: NA
  nMinWindows: 1
  strBPMode: "separate"
  bExport: TRUE
  strContext: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(gsm.kri)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Unset YAML params arrive as NA.
param <- function(x, default = NULL) {
  if (is.null(x) || (is.atomic(x) && length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) default else x
}
dfResults <- param(params$dfResults)
dfMetrics <- param(params$dfMetrics)
lListings <- params$lListings
dSnapshotDate <- param(params$dSnapshotDate)
# HTML for a line above the title, e.g. where the report is embedded.
strContext <- param(params$strContext, "")
bExport <- isTRUE(params$bExport)

# One classification feeds every section.
lClass <- rm_Classify(
  lListings,
  dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
  nWindowLength = param(params$nWindowLength),
  strFlagRule = param(params$strFlagRule, "count"),
  vFlagThresholds = param(params$vFlagThresholds),
  nMinWindows = param(params$nMinWindows, 1)
)
# Every vital: the six KRI vitals, paired BP, height, BSA and any other.
dfVitals <- lClass$vitals
nW <- lClass$meta$window_length
has_participants <- nrow(lClass$participants) > 0
has_vs <- has_participants && nrow(lClass$measurements) > 0
has_evaluable <- any(lClass$participants$flag %in% c("Red", "Amber", "Green"))

# The Settings panel starts from these; the other rule keeps its defaults.
lSettings <- list(
  rule = lClass$meta$rule,
  thresholds = list(
    count = if (lClass$meta$rule == "count") lClass$meta$thresholds else rm_FlagThresholds("count"),
    rate = if (lClass$meta$rule == "rate") lClass$meta$thresholds else rm_FlagThresholds("rate", dfMetrics = dfMetrics)
  ),
  minWindows = lClass$meta$min_windows,
  bp = param(params$strBPMode, "separate")
)
in_cmp <- lClass$meta$window_source == "metrics"
dfRecon <- rm_Reconcile(lClass$participants, dfResults)
dfSites <- rm_SiteFlagRows(lClass, dfResults, dfMetrics)
lSiteRule <- rm_SiteRule(dfMetrics)

tiles <- rm_ParticipantTiles(lClass)
listing <- rm_VitalsListing(rm_VitalRows(lClass), nWindowLength = nW, bExport = bExport)
data_table <- rm_DataTable(
  rm_DataTableData(lClass),
  rm_DataTableWide(lClass),
  lClass$vitals,
  bExport = bExport
)

# rmFilters.js rewrites .rm-rule-text when the reviewer changes the settings.
th <- lClass$meta$thresholds
rule_text <- sprintf(
  "<span class=\"rm-rule-text\">%s; participants need %s window%s for a flag</span>",
  if (lClass$meta$rule == "rate") {
    sprintf("%% of windows that repeat, Amber \u2265 %s%%, Red \u2265 %s%%", format(100 * th[1]), format(100 * th[2]))
  } else {
    sprintf("repeating windows, Amber \u2265 %s, Red \u2265 %s", format(th[1]), format(th[2]))
  },
  lClass$meta$min_windows,
  if (lClass$meta$min_windows == 1) "" else "s"
)

# A section description as a pandoc fenced div, so markdown (bold, lists)
# still renders inside it.
desc <- function(...) cat("\n::: {.rm-desc}\n", ..., "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r header, echo=FALSE}
# One card says what the reader is looking at. The H1 is HTML rather than
# markdown and .toc-ignore, so the contents list starts at the first section.
pill <- function(label, ..., class = NULL) {
  htmltools::tags$span(class = paste(c("rm-pill", class), collapse = " "), htmltools::tags$b(label), ...)
}
htmltools::tags$header(
  id = "rm-header",
  class = "rm-header",
  if (nzchar(strContext)) htmltools::tags$div(class = "rm-ctx", htmltools::HTML(strContext)),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "rm-title",
    htmltools::tags$h1(class = "toc-ignore", "Repeat Measurements"),
    htmltools::tags$button(id = "rm-how-toggle", type = "button", class = "rm-btn", `aria-expanded` = "false", `aria-controls` = "rm-how", "How to read")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "rm-meta",
    pill("Study", paste(unique(lListings$Mapped_SUBJ$studyid), collapse = ", ")),
    if (!is.null(dSnapshotDate)) pill("Snapshot", format(dSnapshotDate)),
    pill("Window", paste("W =", nW)),
    pill("Participant flag", htmltools::HTML(rule_text), class = "rm-pill-rule")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    id = "rm-how",
    class = "rm-how",
    hidden = NA,
    htmltools::HTML(sprintf('<ul>
<li>A <strong>window</strong> is %1$s consecutive measurements of one vital for one participant, in date order (visit breaks ties; missing values skipped). A window <strong>repeats</strong> when all %1$s values are identical. Each participant and vital has <strong>N</strong> repeating windows of <strong>D</strong> windows; the KRIs <code>kri0020a</code>&ndash;<code>f</code> sum N and D by site.</li>
<li>Participants are <strong>evaluable</strong> for a vital once they have enough windows. Flag rule: %2$s. Change the rule, thresholds and minimum windows under <strong>Settings</strong> in the bar below; participant flags in every section follow, while site flags keep the KRI rule.</li>
<li><strong>Blood pressure</strong> (Settings): <em>Separate</em> shows systolic and diastolic BP (the KRIs); <em>Combined</em> shows paired BP, where a window repeats only when both readings repeat over the same visits (no KRI); <em>Both</em> shows all three.</li>
<li>Pick measures under <strong>Measures</strong> in the bar below, or click a measure in the Study overview, to focus every section except the Study overview, which always covers the whole study. Click a country or site to filter; remove a filter with its &times; or all of them with <strong>Reset filters</strong>.</li>
<li>The last three sections drill down from one row per participant (Participant Listing) to one per participant and vital (Vitals listing) to one per value or visit record (Data table). Click a participant, tile or row in any of them to filter the whole report to that participant; click it again to clear.</li>
</ul>', nW, rule_text))
  )
)
```

```{r filter-strip, echo=FALSE}
# htmltools, not raw HTML, so pandoc does not wrap the controls in a <p>.
seg <- function(label, attr, values, selected) {
  htmltools::tags$span(
    class = "rm-seg",
    role = "group",
    `aria-label` = label,
    lapply(names(values), function(v) {
      htmltools::tags$button(
        type = "button",
        `data-rm-set` = attr,
        value = v,
        `aria-pressed` = if (identical(v, selected)) "true" else "false",
        values[[v]]
      )
    })
  )
}
num <- function(id, label, min, step) {
  htmltools::tags$label(
    label,
    htmltools::tags$input(id = id, type = "number", min = min, step = step),
    htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-unit", `data-rm-unit` = id)
  )
}
dot <- function(color) {
  htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-dot", style = sprintf("background:%1$s;border-color:%1$s", color))
}
set_row <- function(label, control, help = NULL, `for` = NULL) {
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "rm-set-row",
    htmltools::tags$label(class = "rm-set-l", `for` = `for`, label),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "rm-set-c", control),
    if (!is.null(help)) htmltools::tags$div(class = "rm-set-h", help)
  )
}
# A popover under the Settings button, filled by rmFilters.js from the
# settings in #rm-data.
rm_SettingsPanel <- function() {
  htmltools::tags$div(
    id = "rm-settings",
    class = "rm-settings",
    role = "dialog",
    `aria-label` = "Report settings",
    hidden = NA,
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "rm-set-head",
      htmltools::tags$b("Report settings"),
      htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-set-hint", "Participant flags follow; site flags keep the KRI rule \u00b7 Esc to close")
    ),
    set_row(
      "Blood pressure",
      seg("Blood pressure", "bp", c(separate = "Separate", combined = "Combined", both = "Both"), lSettings$bp),
      "Separate: systolic and diastolic BP (the KRIs). Combined: paired BP, where a window repeats only when both readings repeat."
    ),
    set_row(
      "Participant flag",
      seg("Flag rule", "rule", c(count = "# windows", rate = "% of windows"), lSettings$rule),
      "Count repeating windows, or their share of the participant\u2019s windows."
    ),
    set_row(
      "Thresholds",
      htmltools::tagList(
        num("rm-th-amber", htmltools::tagList(dot("#FEAA02"), "Amber \u2265"), 0, "any"),
        num("rm-th-red", htmltools::tagList(dot("#FF5859"), "Red \u2265"), 0, "any")
      )
    ),
    set_row(
      "Minimum windows",
      htmltools::tagList(
        htmltools::tags$input(id = "rm-min-windows", type = "number", min = 1, step = 1),
        htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-unit", `data-rm-unit` = "rm-min-windows"),
        htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-unit", "per participant and vital")
      ),
      "Participants with fewer windows are not evaluable.",
      `for` = "rm-min-windows"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "rm-set-foot",
      htmltools::tags$button(id = "rm-settings-defaults", type = "button", class = "rm-ghost", "Restore defaults"),
      htmltools::tags$span(id = "rm-settings-msg", class = "rm-settings-msg", role = "status"),
      htmltools::tags$button(id = "rm-settings-done", type = "button", class = "rm-btn rm-pri", "Done")
    )
  )
}
chip <- function(key, label) {
  htmltools::tags$span(
    id = paste0("rm-chip-", key),
    class = "rm-chip",
    style = "display:none;",
    htmltools::tags$span(label, ": ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-chip-value")),
    htmltools::tags$button(
      type = "button",
      `data-rm-clear` = key,
      `aria-label` = paste("Clear", tolower(label), "filter"),
      htmltools::HTML("&times;")
    )
  )
}
kri_badge <- function(strMetric) {
  if (!is.na(strMetric)) htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-kri", title = strMetric, "KRI")
}
# rmFilters.js hides the BP options the Blood pressure setting does not show.
vital_select <- htmltools::tags$span(
  class = "rm-ms",
  htmltools::tags$button(
    id = "rm-vital-btn",

  htmltools::tags$div(

      class = "rm-ms-all",

    ),
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(dfVitals)), function(i) {
      htmltools::tags$label(
        `data-rm-vital-opt` = dfVitals$vital[i],
        htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", value = dfVitals$vital[i], `data-rm-vital-cb` = NA, checked = NA),

htmltools::tags$div(
  id = "rm-filter-strip",
  class = "rm-filter-strip",
  htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-eyebrow", "Measures"),
  vital_select,
  htmltools::tags$span(
    class = "rm-chips",

    chip("site", "Site"),
    chip("subj", "Participant")

  htmltools::tags$span(id = "rm-count", class = "rm-count", title = "Filters apply to every section except the Study overview."),
  htmltools::tags$button(id = "rm-reset", type = "button", class = "rm-ghost", title = "Clear the vitals, country, site and participant filters", "Reset filters"),
  htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-vr"),
```

```{r degraded, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!has_participants) {
  cat("\n> **No enrolled participants.** Every section is empty for this snapshot.\n")
} else if (!has_vs) {
  cat("\n> **No vital signs recorded.** `Mapped_VS` has no measurements for the enrolled participants, so no participant is evaluable.\n")
} else if (!has_evaluable) {
  nNeeded <- nW + lClass$meta$min_windows - 1
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n> **No evaluable participants** at the initial settings: none has the %s measurements of a vital needed for %s window%s of %s.\n",
    nNeeded, lClass$meta$min_windows, if (lClass$meta$min_windows == 1) "" else "s", nW
  ))
}
if (length(lClass$meta$split_sites) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n> **%s site%s with participants in more than one country** (%s). As in the country KRIs, each participant counts toward their own country, so %s counted in each of %s countries.\n",
    length(lClass$meta$split_sites), if (length(lClass$meta$split_sites) == 1) "" else "s",
    htmltools::htmlEscape(paste(lClass$meta$split_sites, collapse = ", ")),
    if (length(lClass$meta$split_sites) == 1) "the site is" else "each site is",
    if (length(lClass$meta$split_sites) == 1) "its" else "their"
  ))
}
if (!in_cmp) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n> The repeat-measure KRIs (`kri0020a`&ndash;`f`) are not in this study's metrics. The report uses W = %s (%s) and flags sites at Amber \u2265 %s%%, Red \u2265 %s%% of windows, with at least %s windows.\n",
    nW,
    if (lClass$meta$window_source == "argument") "report argument" else "default",
    format(100 * lSiteRule$thresholds[1]), format(100 * lSiteRule$thresholds[2]), lSiteRule$accrual
  ))
}
```

```{r reconcile, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (is.null(dfRecon)) {
  cat("<p class=\"rm-recon\">No <code>kri0020</code> results to reconcile with.</p>\n")
} else {
  cat(
    "<p class=\"rm-recon\">Reconciliation with the KRI (all enrolled participants, latest snapshot): ",
    paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(dfRecon)), function(i) {
      r <- dfRecon[i, ]
      short <- rm_Vitals()$short[match(r$vital, rm_Vitals()$vital)]
      if (r$match) {
        sprintf("%s %s/%s <span class=\"ok\">= %s &#10003;</span>", short, r$Numerator, r$Denominator, r$metric)
      } else {
        sprintf(
          "%s %s/%s <span class=\"bad\">&ne; %s (%s/%s) &#10007;</span>",
          short, r$Numerator, r$Denominator, r$metric, r$kri_Numerator, r$kri_Denominator
        )
      }
    }, character(1)), collapse = " &middot; "),
    "</p>\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
cat(sprintf(
  "<p class=\"rm-recon\">W = %s (%s) &middot; Flag rule: %s.</p>\n",
  nW,
  switch(lClass$meta$window_source, metrics = "from the kri0020 metrics", argument = "report argument", default = "default"),
  rule_text
))
```

```{r dist-controls, echo=FALSE, eval=has_participants}
dist_seg <- function(label, attr, values, selected) {
  htmltools::tags$span(
    class = "rm-seg",
    role = "group",
    `aria-label` = label,
    lapply(names(values), function(v) {
      htmltools::tags$button(
        id = paste0("rm-dist-", v),
        type = "button",
        `data-rm-dist` = attr,
        value = v,
        `aria-pressed` = if (identical(v, selected)) "true" else "false",
        values[[v]]
      )
    })
  )
}
# rmFilters.js draws the table from the tiles, #rm-data and the settings.
htmltools::tagList(

      class = "rm-grp",
      "Cells",
      dist_seg("Cells", "unit", c(participants = "Participant flags", sites = "Site flags"), "participants")
    ),
    htmltools::tags$span(class = "rm-grp", "Flags", dist_seg("Flags", "flag", c(all = "All rows", any = "Any flag", red = "Red"), "all")),
    htmltools::tags$input(id = "rm-dist-search", type = "search", placeholder = "Search site or country", hidden = NA),
    htmltools::tags$span(id = "rm-dist-count", class = "rm-unit")
  ),

  htmltools::tags$p(id = "rm-dist-legend", class = "rm-legend"),
  htmltools::div(id = "rm-dist-tip", class = "rm-tip", hidden = NA)
)
```

```{r rm-data, echo=FALSE, eval=has_participants}
lData <- list(
  sites = dfSites[c("vital", "invid", "flag", "source")],
  siteRule = list(thresholds = lSiteRule$thresholds, accrual = jsonlite::unbox(lSiteRule$accrual)),
  vitals = lClass$vitals,
  participants = unique(lClass$participants[c("subjid", "invid", "country")]),
  # Unboxed so the scalars arrive as JSON scalars, not length-1 arrays.
  settings = list(
    rule = jsonlite::unbox(lSettings$rule),
    thresholds = lSettings$thresholds,
    minWindows = jsonlite::unbox(lSettings$minWindows),
    bp = jsonlite::unbox(lSettings$bp)
  ),
  export = bExport
)
# 17 significant digits round-trip every double, so the browser compares
# windows with exactly R's thresholds (15 can flip a flag at the boundary).
htmltools::tags$script(
  type = "application/json",
  id = "rm-data",
  htmltools::HTML(gsub(
    "<", "\\\\u003c",
    jsonlite::toJSON(lData, dataframe = "rows", na = "null", null = "null", digits = I(17))
  ))
)
```
